## 2026-09-08 01:46
Root cause: WORKLOG_DIR/--dir moves only the projection corpus. The sqlite source-of-truth still resolves via WORKLOG_MIGRATION_DATA or ~/.local/share/worklog-migration (cli/task_store.go:174), and devboard via DEVBOARD_DATA (devboard/devboard.go:221). openStoreForWrite (cli/store_common.go:110) renders the REAL store and byte-diffs against the fresh dir; absent files count as deletion-edits (projection/projection.go:201), so every projection reads as hand-edited and the write refuses. The guard is protective: bypassing it would commit scratch writes into the real store and render the real corpus into the scratch dir. Recommend (a) a single switch that moves all three roots (worklog init <dir> / --scratch, or store+devboard nested under the workdir), (b) a targeted diagnostic for the 'corpus never rendered from this store' case, (c) document all three env vars in README/--help.
